releaseNotes:
- Faster: SOS now sends immediately using your last known location - no more waiting on GPS
- Faster: home screen loads volunteers and requests together, and keeps showing your data while refreshing
- Fix: SOS and app loading are quicker, and background location name lookups no longer slow the app
- Fix: language switcher no longer overlaps app content - moved to splash and onboarding screens only
- Better messages: technical errors are now shown in plain, friendly language (EN & Urdu)
- Settings > Data and permissions rewritten in clear, simple language
